notes: No team change; spent rookie year (2025) partly on IR, now competing with Jaydon Blue for the No. 2 RB job behind Javonte Williams - roster spot close to a lock but game-day role less certain.

timeline.role: Competing for RB2 behind starter Javonte Williams, against Malik Davis and Jaydon Blue; impressed at OTAs (red-zone TD, called 'night-and-day different' by coaches) tightening the competition, though Davis remained the favorite as of mid-June 2026
timeline.note: No confirmed depth-chart rank yet as of source date; RB2 battle described as tighter than expected after strong OTAs

timeline.role: Released by Dallas; signed to New York Giants practice squad [news 2026-09-14]. Giants RB room led by Cam Skattebo, with Devin Singletary and Tyrone Tracy Jr. ahead of him. Sleeper API still lists DAL/active-roster RB4, which appears stale.
